study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized community non-inferiority trial
exposure: Treatment for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) along with usual prenatal care for women with first-trimester fasting plasma glucose (FPG) 5.1-5.6 mmol/l
Usual prenatal care for women with first-trimester fasting plasma glucose (FPG) 5.1-5.6 mmol/l
cohort: The study included 3297 pregnant women who had fasting plasma glucose (FPG) values ranging 5.1-5.6 mmol/l in the first trimester of gestation.
finding: Treating women with first-trimester fasting plasma glucose values of 5.1-5.6 mmol/l did not statistically significantly improve adverse pregnancy outcomes, including macrosomia, primary C-S, preterm birth, and other listed complications.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in the adjusted risks of primary cesarean-section between the treatment and control groups.
